title: Optimize GROUP BY container preallocation
constraints: Preserve GROUP BY, HAVING, aggregate, and projection semantics
rationale: The GROUP BY aggregate path has stable upper bounds for aggregate expression count, input rows, group-key width, output group count, per-group aggregate map size, and projection width. Preallocating these containers reduces allocator growth during grouped aggregation.
steps: Preallocate aggregate expression storage from projection and HAVING bounds
Preallocate group map from input row count
Preallocate group keys from GROUP BY expression count
Preallocate grouped output rows and per-group aggregate maps
expected_impact: Reduces allocation churn in grouped aggregate execution without changing query results.
